title: RefereeSim: A Proof-of-Concept Evaluation Framework for AI-Powered Scientific Paper Reviewers

contributions.purpose: 提供可复现、有ground-truth的AI审稿评估流水线
contributions.mechanism: RefereeSim四模块(合成论文生成器+错误注入器+多模型运行器+评估引擎),在受控条件下注入带标注的不一致错误
contributions.evaluation: 本次仅注入单一样本量误报(摘要2068 vs 方法1991),统一prompt评测11个模型
contributions.source_quote: A transparent, reproducible evaluation pipeline that aligns reviewer outputs with seeded ground truth

contributions.purpose: 给出多厂商模型在基础一致性检查上的首个快照
contributions.mechanism: 以'flag不一致+引用两处章节+报对数值'为正确判定标准统计各模型
contributions.source_quote: Only 4 of 11 models (36.4%) identified the discrepancy. Detection was perfect within the Cohere (2/2) and Gemini (2/2) families, and absent for DeepSeek (0/3), Llama (0/3)

contributions.purpose: 提炼构建安全AI审稿的工程化设计原则
contributions.mechanism: 把审稿拆成结构化多趟(事实抽取→对齐→检查)并要求location/value级引用、缺证据时fail-closed
contributions.evaluation: 定性:成功模型均遵循'抽数→对齐→比较'一致协议,失败模式为泛泛评论/单段推理/含糊措辞
contributions.source_quote: Structure the task into passes (facts extraction -> alignment -> checks) rather than a single free-form critique; and Require citations to locations and values for any flagged issue

self_declared_provenance.quote: Domain-specific tools such as GRIM and related tests demonstrate that targeted, rule-based checks can reveal pervasive reporting anomalies. Our work examines whether general-purpose LLMs can perform analogous consistency checks when prompted as reviewers.

notes: 核心是负结果:即便在最有利受控条件下多数生产模型仍漏掉基础跨章节数值一致性(4/11)。规模无用:405B/120B大模型全失,Cohere/Gemini小模型全对。作者自承极窄(单篇合成论文+单一错误类型),统计显著性checklist答[NA]。AI Involvement Checklist:1-4项全[D](AI为lead author,生成idea/设计/执行/写作,人类仅提供API key与提交格式)。无编号贡献列表,按abstract Contributions(1)(2)(3)归纳。
